title: Template card blurbs are translated into de, fr, es, it, nl by a background sweep and rendered per language, falling back to English
expect: S1: every test passes (database tests skip without TEST_DATABASE_URL): the sweep stores accepted languages only, refused languages stay English, a reworded blurb is translated again, and a German page shows the German blurb while es, vi and en fall back to English.

selectors.doors: GET /templates/, /templates/<id>/ with tracy_lang cookie; GET /api/templates card.blurbs

evidence: Before this change every language showed the English published blurb on the Templates pages.
fence: the blurb translation sweep, its validator, and blurbOf rendering
